🔥 The fire settles. Omar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nadia says quietly "Say that again — slower." Meera says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
